# decides what they are. Uncomment to import.

# --- Resolved, but packed as directories ----------------------------------
# These three are in gamevault-library-packmap.tsv instead, because the game is
# a directory here and any single file out of it is a dead end.
# fable/ — confirmed Fable: The Lost Chapters (2005), not Fable III. The disc
#   root holds FABLE___THE_LOST_CHAPTERS.MSI and DISK1C_1.CAB..DISK4C_1.CAB, so
#   the "Fabl3" folder name was misleading. The .mdf also needs its .mds to
#   mount, and the folder carries serial.txt and a Spanish translation.
# Final.Fantasy.I-VI.Pixel.Remaster.MULTi12/ — elamigos-1.bin sits next to
#   setup-0.bin and setup-1.bin. One part of a multi-part installer; serving it
#   alone gives a broken download.
# ESDL.ERDR/ — CD1+CD2+CD3, labels ESDLA3-CD1/2/3. That is El Retorno del Rey
#   (2003), the EA action game, not the Battle for Middle-earth strategy games
#   above. Different series, similar folder name.
# Escape.From.Monkey.Island/ — CD1+CD2 of a game already imported from the
#   Monkey Island Collection. A duplicate, not a gap.
# Toradora[EN][1.00]/ — manual.pdf, xdelta3.exe and toradora.patch. An English
#   translation patch, not the game.
# Nothing else in the collection is a game: four empty folders (fallout3,
# fallout3(expansiones), Façade, Sims3v1.17(No-DVD)), a loose Assassin's Creed
# crack, "call 4", Factorio mods, PS2 tooling under piratearps2/, and a stray
# Hero00.pax. The CoDWaW/ and cod4/ patch installers stay too — the games
# themselves came in as ISOs above.
